ctaHeading: Fawkner's HVAC experts are ready to assist you.
aboutText: President Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Services has been providing top-notch air conditioning and refrigeration solutions to Fawkner and surrounding suburbs for over a decade. Our team of licensed professionals is dedicated to ensuring your comfort with efficient installations, timely repairs, and regular maintenance. We understand the local climate and tailor our services to meet the unique needs of Victorian homes and businesses. Trust us to keep your spaces cool in summer and warm in winter.
servicesSubheading: Expert air conditioning and refrigeration care
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of services including installation, repair, and maintenance for all types of air conditioning and refrigeration systems. Our skilled technicians are equipped to handle residential, commercial, and industrial projects, ensuring optimal performance and energy efficiency.

services.title: Air Conditioning Installation
services.desc: We install split systems, ducted air conditioning, and more, ensuring perfect climate control for your Fawkner home or office.

services.title: Air Conditioning Repair
services.desc: Our technicians quickly diagnose and fix issues with all AC brands, restoring comfort to your space efficiently.

services.title: Refrigeration System Installation
services.desc: We set up commercial and domestic refrigeration units, from walk-in coolers to display fridges, with precision.

services.title: Preventive Maintenance
services.desc: Regular servicing keeps your HVAC systems running smoothly, preventing breakdowns and extending their lifespan.

services.title: Commercial HVAC Services
services.desc: We provide tailored solutions for businesses in Fawkner, including offices, restaurants, and retail spaces.

services.title: Emergency Breakdowns
services.desc: We offer prompt emergency repairs for air conditioning and refrigeration failures, minimising disruption.
